name: tilttek/progression-bundle
description: Levels and streaks for Symfony on tilttek/progression: tracks, curves, seasons, milestones and streaks in configuration, stored in Doctrine DBAL, the projection fed by tilttek/activity-bundle, events on levels, milestones and broken streaks, Twig progress bar and streak, commands, and member export and erasure

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the progression's tables to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's progression with the rest of their account
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that sweep the broken streaks and show a subject's progression
suggest.symfony/translation: To translate the templates' texts and the names of the tracks and streaks
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the Twig functions and the templates of the progress bar and the streak
suggest.tilttek/activity-bundle: To keep the journal of activity the rules and the streaks read, and catch the progression projection up live or by a command
